title: ApprovalDecision (DRAFT)
description: One person's decision on one request. Append-only: never updated, never deleted. DRAFT — not approved.

decidedBy.description: Must not be the requester (GOV-003), enforced by a database trigger as well as in code.

roleHeld.description: The office held at the moment of decision, stored on the decision itself. If the President changes next year, the history of this decision must not change with them.

reason.description: Required when rejecting: a refusal the submitter cannot understand cannot be acted on.

assuranceLevel.description: Recorded as evidence that the step-up demanded by the permission actually happened. parcel.approve_boundary requires aal3, so the President needs phishing-resistant authentication before boundary approval can work at all.
